text: The per-service login of rwb-agent (DP-02) is not named by the sources; the story calls it "the rwb-agent login (DP-02)" until the ACE DB story names it, and SY-AGENT stays the actor name of a run.
why: No read-only source names the DB login of a service; only the naming rule login-per-service is fixed.
read: Template and Rules v1 §R4; context pack P10 service row; TSD P10 Appendix T-A (no login).
impact: Naming only; no behaviour changes and no code value is added.

text: The rwb-deviation slice that publishes the raise operation is not named by any source; the raise is consumed as a published REST contract with a fake, one hop and the 2 s budget, and no contract dependency is claimed.
why: The legacy story calls an in-process interface (DeviationService.raise) and names no target story for the S8 owner.
read: Legacy RWB-E2-029 v1 §12; Template and Rules v1 §R5.4 class C and §R5.5 DP-11.
impact: The app story builds against the fake; the real behaviour is proved by RWB-ITG-W2.

text: The raise is taken with the request members caseId, deviationCode, reason, documentIds, raisedBy and agentRunId, and the answer members deviationId and decisionLogEntryId, mapped from the legacy Java signature.
why: The legacy signature is the only source, and a REST shape has to be fixed for the fake and the app story.
read: Legacy RWB-E2-029 v1 §12 (DeviationService.raise and its return).
impact: A renamed member is a contract change and is corrected in RWB-P10-E2029-CON first.

text: The read of a sealed decision-log entry from rwb-decision is assumed as a GET on the decision base by entry ID, because the legacy story only names the entry ID it stores.
why: agent_feedback.decision_log_id needs a value and the legacy writer is replaced by the local library plus the central ledger.
read: Legacy RWB-E2-029 v1 §12 and §13; Template and Rules v1 §R5.5 DP-03.
impact: The entry ID is stored either way; only the read path may change.

text: The parameter keys that carry the confidence floor 0.80, the segment values and the promotion condition are not named; the story reads them from the rwb-case parameters contract and holds no default, refusing the load or the run when a key is absent.
why: The values are policy and parameter rows under principle 1 and no source lists the keys.
read: FSD P10 Agent runtime v3 A2.8.3 and A2.12.3.2; Template and Rules v1 §R5.5 DP-06.
impact: No code value is written; a missing key is a refusal, not a default.

text: The rwb.agent.AgentRunCompleted.v1 payload carries the run facts and the two segment members of TSD P10 T3.1 in addition to the baseline members, because AC1 of the legacy story reads the segment of a run.
why: No source names the payload members of EV-28 for this key and the app story needs the segment of the run.
read: TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1 (DF-AGT-036 to DF-AGT-060); legacy RWB-E2-029 v1 §12.
confirm: rwb-agent contract owner and the event platform owner
impact: A registry subject covers the added members; no personal field is carried.

text: The interaction-ledger read of rwb-source-data for the entries of a case in a window is assumed as a case query on the source-data base; the window is the one fixed by the screening run path and this key sets none.
why: The legacy story reads the ledger in process and the target owner is rwb-source-data under the default ruling.
read: Legacy RWB-E2-029 v1 §11 and §12; Template and Rules v1 §R3 default rulings and §R5.5 DP-05, DP-18.
impact: The preceding contact of X1 and the X7 appraisal date keep their values; only the path may change.

text: The gateway-bff route in front of the panel read and the verdict is a pass-through of one hop; its name and path are not fixed and the story names none.
why: DP-19 requires a composite route and no read-only source names it.
read: Template and Rules v1 §R5.5 DP-19; context pack P10 naming rules (gateway-bff).
impact: The screen reaches the service only through the route; a fixed path is a contract change in RWB-P10-E2029-CON.

text: This key creates no table and no migration; the Flyway sequence of rwb_agent is not extended and every column used already exists from the earlier P10 stories.
why: The legacy story states "no new table" and DP-15 is not a pattern of this key.
read: Legacy RWB-E2-029 v1 §13; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1; Template and Rules v1 §R5.5 DP-15.
confirm: ACE team (DB) and the rwb-agent tech lead
impact: If a column is found missing it is added by the P10 DB story, not here.

text: The legacy feature flag rwb.agent.screening-l1 is kept as a reference and read through the platform feature-flag library; when it is off every segment runs in shadow and the panel is hidden.
why: The legacy story defines the flag as a local property and the target library owns feature flags.
read: Legacy RWB-E2-029 v1 §13 (feature flag); Template and Rules v1 §R3 default rulings (feature flags - platform library).
impact: No business value changes; the flag is not a policy row and is not written in code.

text: The score row of an evaluation carries the five members beyond the baseline AgentEvaluation - truePositive, falsePositive, falseNegative, precisionValue and recallValue - taken from TSD P10 T3.1 DF-AGT-091 to DF-AGT-096.
why: Legacy AC1 reads the counts and both ratios, and the baseline report shape has no place for them.
read: TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1 (agent_evaluation); legacy RWB-E2-029 v1 AC1.
confirm: rwb-agent tech lead and the data steward
impact: A row whose counts do not reproduce its ratios fails the contract test; no value is invented.

text: A confirmation stores the entry ID returned by the rwb-deviation raise, a rejection writes one record through the local library before its feedback, and the pair (agent_run_id, item_key) is the only idempotency key of a verdict.
why: The legacy writer is replaced by the local record library plus the central ledger and one feedback per item must hold across confirmations.
read: Legacy RWB-E2-029 v1 §2, §12 and §13; Template and Rules v1 §R5.5 DP-03, DP-09.
confirm: rwb-agent tech lead and rwb-decision (P7) contract owner
impact: The record and the feedback are one transaction or neither; the refusal is 503 with MSG-P7-003.

why: Cited by _work/msr/editlog/B2-P10-003.md; see the story body for the default used.
confirm: Tech lead confirms during the verification loop
